label: Remote link (Analytics)
type: an analytics:analytics-link connecting an Analytics scope to a DIFFERENT, remote Couchbase cluster's Data service - sibling of analytics:local-link (same cluster) and the external-link type (a non-Couchbase source such as S3). Editable and deletable, unlike a local link. Offers an encryption-type configuration choice a local link has no equivalent of.
evidence: A remote link is a link to a remote Couchbase cluster.
Disconnecting a local link or a remote link disconnects all collections on that link from their data sources.
Open the Encryption Type drop-down list and select the type of encryption:
relates_to_competency_question: Can Analytics shadow data from a different Couchbase cluster entirely, and does that connection support encryption the same way a local link would?
